summary: The 2026 LLM landscape is dominated by three frontier vendors — OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google — whose models reach enterprises both directly and through cloud aggregators like AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex. Open-weight models from Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Alibaba continue to drive massive HuggingFace download volumes and cost-sensitive adoption. Pricing has collapsed dramatically year-over-year, with capable frontier-class models now available at a fraction of 2025 costs.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.popularity_notes: Remains the most-called general-purpose model across developer APIs and is available through Azure OpenAI, giving it enormous enterprise aggregator reach.
models.best_for: General-purpose production applications requiring multimodal capabilities

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Released February 17, 2026 matching Opus-level performance at Sonnet pricing; dominant for coding and available via AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Snowflake Cortex.
models.best_for: Coding assistants and agentic enterprise workflows

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.popularity_notes: The context-window leader with deep native integration into Google Vertex AI and Workspace, driving heavy enterprise adoption.
models.best_for: Long-context document analysis and multimodal tasks at scale

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.popularity_notes: High-volume, low-cost workhorse for latency-sensitive applications with large context and strong Vertex AI aggregator reach.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6
models.popularity_notes: Released February 5, 2026 as Anthropic's flagship frontier model, widely used for complex reasoning and available across AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.
models.best_for: Complex reasoning and high-stakes agentic workflows

models.name: DeepSeek R1
models.popularity_notes: A 671B-parameter MoE (37B active) reasoning model and the cheapest frontier-class option, driving huge open-weight download volumes on HuggingFace.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.popularity_notes: One of the most-downloaded open-weight models on HuggingFace and widely hosted across AWS Bedrock, Azure, and Vertex AI for self-managed deployments.

models.name: DeepSeek V3
models.popularity_notes: A highly efficient open-weight MoE model delivering near-frontier general performance at very low cost, with strong HuggingFace adoption.
models.best_for: Cost-sensitive general-purpose applications with open weights

models.name: Mistral Large 2
models.popularity_notes: A popular European open-weight-friendly frontier model available through Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Vertex AI, favored for data-sovereignty-conscious enterprises.

models.name: Qwen3-235B-A22B
models.popularity_notes: A leading open-weight MoE model with rapidly growing HuggingFace downloads and strong adoption in Asian markets and the global open-source community.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.popularity_notes: Anthropic's fast, low-cost model gaining strong adoption for high-volume tasks and available across AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI.
